args.title: checkout-api v2.3.1 failing health checks — rolled back to v2.3.0
args.summary: checkout-api v2.3.1 deployed to production failed health checks in all regions (error rate ~18%). Remedy taken: rolled back checkout-api in all production regions (us-east, us-west, eu-west) to v2.3.0, the most recent release that was healthy in production. The first rollback attempt halted after us-east due to an orchestrator error; a retry completed the rollout to all regions. Post-rollback status: all regions on v2.3.0, service healthy, error rate back to ~0.2%. Follow-up needed: investigate root cause of v2.3.1 failure and the orchestrator partial-rollout error before re-attempting a release.

trace.final:
Done. Summary of actions:

1. **Diagnosis**: checkout-api was on v2.3.1, failing health checks in all three production regions (us-east, us-west, eu-west) with an error rate of ~18%. Per the release history, the most recent healthy production release was **v2.3.0**.

2. **Rollback**: Rolled checkout-api back to v2.3.0 in all production regions.
   - The first rollback attempt partially failed (halted after us-east due to an orchestrator error), leaving regions in a mixed state.
   - I retried the rollback, which completed the rollout: all regions are now on v2.3.0.

3. **Verification**: Post-rollback status shows all regions healthy on v2.3.0 with the error rate down to ~0.2%.

4. **Incident**: Opened a **SEV2** incident (INC-0001) for checkout-api documenting the v2.3.1 failure, the rollback to v2.3.0, the orchestrator partial-failure during the rollback, and follow-up actions (root-cause v2.3.1's failure and investigate the orchestrator error before re-attempting the release). This paged the on-call engineer.
